name: Off-delay timer relay
summary: An off-delay timer holds a specified output condition for a documented period after its initiating condition is removed.
description: An off-delay timer holds a specified output condition for a documented period after its initiating condition is removed. Its auxiliary power requirements depend on the selected timer.
readingNotes: Determine whether the device needs a continuing supply to complete the delay.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Off-delay is not the same as a minimum pulse duration generated when the trigger first arrives.
